_about: Company settings for the AI Assistant (one file per company; adding a company = adding a file, never a code change). Secrets never go here: feed tokens are read from the environment variable named in token_env.

people._about: Who handles what. key_users see every to-do nobody owns, so nothing is lost. Each role lists addresses that receive that kind of to-do when the product does not name a person.

drafts._about: Who a drafted request goes to when the to-do is an internal hand-off (e.g. 'please invoice file X'). Blank means the user fills in the recipient.
